 Watch Champions League Match of the Day: Arsenal draw, Villa win, Man Utd thrashed
 21 October 2026 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scores 
 Tables 
 Summary
 Use the 'watch & listen' tab for BBC Radio 5 Live commentary or to watch Champions League Final Score
 FT: Bayern 2-2 Arsenal - Eze replaces injured Saka and puts Gunners ahead; Davies responds and Kane nets from spot but Rice levels
 Villa 3-1 Viking - Barkley with opener, Buendia doubles lead from spot before Heggheim own goal; Christiansen responds
 FT: Como 4-1 Man Utd - Paz curls superb opener for hosts after two minutes, Douvikas doubles lead after break before Paz grabs his second and Jacobo Ramon makes it four. Zirkzee with last response
 Read about Italian club's rise here 
 Here's Viking's special story 
 Real Madrid & Inter also win - see all scores here

Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 For all of the controlling moments that there has been in the first half, there's [also] moments where Mikel Arteta will not be happy with because Arsenal look quite open at times, and Bayern Munich are finding the passes to hurt them.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 168 51 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Bayern can 'really cause some damage' published at 20:58 BST 20:58 BST 
 Bayern Munich 1-1 Arsenal 
 Matt Upson 
Former Arsenal defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 There has been some really interesting play. Arsenal have had a clear plan which David Raya has been a part of in how they are going to get forward, and they have had control in parts of the match, but also some very loose parts of the game which is very unlike them.
 I think when Bayern have managed to turn it over, they have looked like they can really cause some damage and they have had the better chances in the game.
 147 86 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Emery still not happy published at 20:56 BST 20:56 BST 
 Aston Villa 2-0 Viking 
 Phil McNulty 
BBC Sport chief football writer at Villa Park 
 Aston Villa manager Unai Emery stormed off at the half-time waving his arms about in fury. Suspect it was with the officials for playing a few added seconds when Viking had a corner but he's not been that happy on a few occasions.
 Surely no complaints about his team - other than they should be even more than two goals ahead.
 238 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:55 BST 20:55 BST 
 HT: Bayern Munich 1-1 Arsenal 
 Nedum Onuoha 
Former Man City defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 It's a little surprising to see Arsenal so open.
 The way Bayern have tried to play at times has led to Arsenal being caught out and being stretched defensively, when we are used to them being so solid, or getting numbers back straight away.
 If Bayern's decision making or final ball was better then Arsenal would be behind at half-time but I am sure Mikel Arteta will speak about it at the break and we might see his side being a bit more cautious in the second half, because clearly Bayern are ready for them to attack, and have got a plan for it. 
 You can hear more from Onuoha on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app.

 A great game published at 20:49 BST 20:49 BST 
 Bayern Munich 1-1 Arsenal 
 Alex Howell 
BBC Sport Arsenal reporter at the Allianz Arena 
 Half time and this is a great watch. 
 Arsenal have been aggressive and played well. 
 It's a great moment for Eze to score after the recent criticism too but the Gunners will be worrying about how bad the injury to Saka injury is. 
 And Harry Kane, wow. Some of the passes this half have been incredible. What a player. 
 Image source, Getty Images
